definitions.explanation: Sexually offensive or morally repugnant. Used to describe language, images, behavior, or content of a sexually vulgar nature.

examples.japanese: {卑猥|ひわい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わないで→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{卑猥|ひわい}な⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧うる。
examples.english: Sending obscene images can be a crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{卑猥|ひわい}な⟦{冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}う→冗談を言う：26094_joudanwoiu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦セクハラ→セクハラ：05905_sekuhara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: Telling lewd jokes in the workplace constitutes sexual harassment.

notes: Also written in kana as ひわい. A legal and formal term used in contexts like {卑猥物|ひわいぶつ} (obscene material) and {公然卑猥|こうぜんひわい} (public indecency). Common collocations: {卑猥|ひわい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (obscene words), {卑猥|ひわい}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (indecent act). Stronger and more formal than エッチ (naughty/sexual, colloquial) or ⟦いやらしい→いやらしい：10233_iyarashii⟧ (dirty, suggestive). Often seen in news reporting and legal contexts.
